notes.title: Update Announcement – V1.5.2 Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Party People;

Guess what? We dropped a fresh update, and trust me, it’s not just lipstick on the pig—real upgrades here:

🌍 That annoying shader thing in region 4? Kicked it to the curb. No more wonky graphics messing with your vibe.

 - Mini Mayhem DLC—they’re not kidding, things actually work now.

⚽ Furball fans, listen up: We squashed that goal bug. If you score, it freakin’ counts. No more screaming at your screen over lost points.

🎨 And the hand-drawn art? We gave it a glow-up, still quirky as heck but even more Party Club energy.

You rock for sticking with us! 💖 We literally thrive on your feedback, so keep dropping your wild ideas, bug rants, and memes in the community hub. You never know what chaos you’ll inspire for the next round. Party on!

notes.title: Party Club Major Update - V1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello there, dear players!

This one's a biggie. We’ve added two of the most requested features to keep your parties fresh and your controls tight. Check it out:

[h2]Keybinding is Here![/h2]

You asked, and we delivered.
You can now fully customize your control layout — both on [b]keyboard[/b] and [b]controllers![/b]
Set up your keys just the way you like and party your way.

[h2]Inventory Items & Costume Drops[/h2]

[list]
[*] Get ready to dress to impress.
[*] We’ve added a brand-new inventory system featuring unlockable cosmetics!
[*] While playing Party Club, you now have a chance to randomly [b]receive cosmetics.[/b]
[*] Collect and equip your favorites to stand out from the crowd.
[*] This update includes [b]7 themed sets[/b], with a total of [b]21 unique costume pieces [/b]to discover!
[/list]

We’ve got more updates coming soon!
As always, thank you for your support and feedback.

Stay fabulous.

notes.title: Update Announcement – V1.3.16
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support! Here's what's included in this update:

[h2]Settings & Accessibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option to toggle ragdoll physics in the settings.
[*] Streamer Mode added — this hides the room code to prevent unwanted players from joining during live streams.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player interaction colliders have been narrowed for more precise targeting.
[*] Tools like the mop and hammer are now prioritized during interactions, making them easier to pick up when needed.
[*] The hold duration required to throw held items has been increased to prevent accidental drops.
[*] You can now start the day by throwing a hammer at the gong from a distance.
[*] Character movement has been made smoother and more responsive.
[/list]

[h2]UI & UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The stats screen will now always display at least one stat — no more empty entries.
[*] Fixed minor UI bugs during menu transitions.
[/list]

[h2]Map & World Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level boundaries have been slightly expanded or adjusted to provide smoother gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could disembark too early from the boat on the world map.
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented some chests from being opened.
[/list]

Thanks again for playing! More updates are on the way — stay tuned!

notes.title: Update Announcement – V1.3.15
notes.content:
[h1]Update Announcement – V1.3.15[/h1]

We've been hard at work fixing bugs and making improvements based on your valuable feedback. Thank you for your continued support! Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h2]Controller Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added dead zones to controller analog sticks to prevent unintended character movement caused by minor stick drift.
[/list]
[h2]Game Closing Issue (Windows & Mac)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting "Exit to Desktop" sometimes failed to properly close the game, causing it to appear as still running on Steam.
[/list]
[h2]Connection Stability[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze for other players if someone disconnected during the join process.
[/list]
[h2]Customer Behavior Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved customer movement algorithms for smoother and more accurate navigation.
[*] Resolved a visual glitch with the Aggressive Guy special customer when exiting the venue.
[/list]
[h2]Object Placement Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where knocking out a player while they were building would make the object unplaceable.
[*] Resolved an issue where objects could disappear if construction was interrupted before completion.
[*] Made improvements to the object placement mechanism.
[/list]
[h2]Interaction Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where table boxes couldn’t be picked up after being removed from chests.
[*] Resolved an issue where the game would sometimes default to keyboard input, preventing controller buttons from working.
[*] Fixed a bug where drink machines occasionally became non-interactable.
[*] Resolved an issue where player knockback would occur while attacking.
[/list]
[h2]Visual & UI Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the guest count text sometimes displayed the wrong number of customers.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the Starter Kit UI was missing an item image.
[*] The To-do list now closes after every object in the list is placed.
[*] Fixed a rare bug in the settings menu where interaction could become stuck, causing the menu to keep sliding.
[/list]
[h2]Map Collider Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several map collider issues that could cause players to get stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue where objects could go outside the map.
[/list]
[h2]UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tools are now highlighted when the player clicks the ping button.
[*] Made visual improvements to the mixer machine.
[/list]

Thank you all for your feedback and support! Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

notes.title: Update Announcement! V1.3.14
notes.content:
Update Announcement! V1.3.14

We’ve been working hard to make Party Club smoother and more stable! In this update, we focused on memory usage and system performance optimizations. We’ve also adjusted the difficulty progression to be more balanced between levels and made the game more user-friendly for new players.

[h2]Memory Usage Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced overall RAM usage by optimizing asset loading and memory management.
[*] Unused assets are now unloaded more aggressively to prevent memory bloat during long play sessions.
[/list]

[h2]Difficulty & Accessibility Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Smoother difficulty progression between levels for a more balanced challenge.
[*] Improved user-friendliness to make the game more accessible for new players.
[/list]

[h2]Stability Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare crashes caused by memory leaks.
[*] Improved garbage collection to prevent memory spikes and slowdowns.
[/list]

[h2]General Performance Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lower CPU and GPU usage in certain mechanics for more stable frame rates.
[*] Reduced stuttering and hitching, especially in long multiplayer sessions.
[/list]

Enjoy this new experience, and thanks for playing Party Club!
